_comment: Hand-curated overrides for the choice slots, applied by tools/extract.cjs.
scope 'fork'   = a whole-day destination choice. Picking one CONSUMES that destination,
so it shows as 'Done on Day N' in every later fork.
scope 'detail' = a sub-choice inside a day you already committed to (which afternoon stop,
how to reach the airport, where to eat). These NEVER consume anything —
otherwise picking the Okutama day trip would grey out its own afternoon,
and the morning-gap stop would grey Gyoen out of the evening outing.
Keys are slot ids, which are day + title slug and deliberately contain NO ordering
number: inserting a new grid must not renumber every slot after it. Retitle a stop in
itinerary.html and you must rename its key here too — the extractor warns if a slot is
uncurated, and defaults it to 'detail' so nothing greys out by accident.
